milestone: ATTR38: ordinary global constant tick compilation
status: Independently accepted bounded implementation; attributed/deferred initializer and wider core obligations remain partial
target: PHP 8.5.10 CLI NTS 64-bit; project-local binary and tests/semantics/profile.json

production.scope: Plain global CONST_DECL lists compile each initializer and real binding in order, with one trailing statement marker after the whole group. Existing NConst receipts certify declarations. The group starts at its first declaration name rather than the const keyword. A constant-context visitor follows published constants/redirects and threads the emitted line independently of diagnostic receipts: literals carry it, direct Closure compilation leaves its end line, unfolded constant names set their source line, and array values precede keys. Callable-bearing constant arrays, deferred construction and unproved attributed contexts retain dependencies. No module 88, runtime, task/state/schema or ownership protocol edits.
production.retained_cut_bridge: The only db4504466-to-5cffe3d42 change seeds LINE from first NConst metadata. Every declaration group in the earlier five normal originals, refusal control and two reached fronts has keyword line equal to first-name line, so their plans and executions are pointwise identical. Their original hashes/revisions remain below; no old source/state replay was run. The new split-header original alone takes the changed branch. Earlier strict-v2 acceptance remains at bda81b2ce, SHA 7765e73e73233f1761ae9f916da17f3bd7f08a78bbf22dc6bc8296788c9bf015.

authority.parser: vendor/php-src/Zend/zend_language_parser.y: const_list builds one CONST_DECL list, unlike the statement-splitting unset/global/static lists. Its first CONST_ELEM uses the name child line; zend_ast_create_3 and zend_ast_create_list_1 in Zend/zend_ast.c preserve that line. The top_statement action does not reset it to the T_CONST keyword line.
authority.compiler: vendor/php-src/Zend/zend_compile.c: zend_compile_const_decl emits every binding before zend_compile_stmt's single Tick. zend_const_expr_to_zval and zend_compile_const_expr traverse the retained constant AST. zend_compile_const_expr_const changes CG(zend_lineno); zend_compile_const_expr_closure calls zend_compile_func_decl_ex, which leaves decl->end_lineno. Pure zvals leave the line unchanged; constant NArrayItem order is value before key.
authority.receipt_distinction: Module 88 ppconstant_emit/ppcall_done restores the diagnostic context before ppconstant_record. Its NConst receipt is therefore not an emitter-line certificate. This distinction is preserved rather than changing existing constant diagnostics/runtime consumers.

author_source.scope: The callback after a two-item declaration sees both constants 1/2; a following single declaration has its own Tick and exposes 3. No intermediate group Tick runs.
